verdicts.rationale: db/pool.yaml raises max_connections 40 to 180 and statement_timeout 5s to 60s (@@ -8,2 +8,2), and db/reporting.sql adds an on-demand revenue rollup joining orders to payments. Long reporting queries can now hold connections for a minute instead of being cancelled at 5s, which drains the pool and produces the 'pool exhausted, 0 idle' waits. It shipped 25 minutes before the alert.
Adds pool acquisition tests under db/tests/; test-only and 18 hours old, so it does not run in production.
Grafana dashboard JSON only; changes visualization, not database behaviour.
